book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Matei

content: Yesu bumpeleka kwaka Pilatu
Pulukela aka agolu akolongu boti na aka aseja ba bandu batenda kulongalane baamua kunkoma Yesu.
Bunkonga, bunzukua nukumpeleka kwaka Pilatu, jojabi kilongosi ju pundema jojahaguliwi nu nkolongu juku Loma.
Kuwa kwaka Yuda
Yuda, joang'anambuka Yesu, pajwabona Yesu atenda kuntemu, gumbina mwoju, jwaakelabukia agolu akolongu bala na aseja, mangengalema makomi matatu gulupija yela.
Jwaapwagila, “Ndei mahakau ndaba nung'anambwiki mundu jwanga mahakau ili jukomika.” Lakini bombi bapwaga, “Kwali wamwete, twepani ngasetuhusika.”
Henu Yuda jwalekala pee lupija lola pa Nyumba jaka Sapanga, ndienu japita kunza nukujenda kulikonge.
Agolu akolongu bajukua lupija lola, nukupwaga, “Lupija alo ngaselupalika kulubeka pi kikoku sa Nyumba jaka Sapanga, ndaba londo lupija lobapia ndaba jukukome.”
Ndi bajetangania lupija lola kulombe litui la bandu baabombe ibega pabia pandu pukutagi bandu ageni.
Ndienu mbaki lelenu litui lela bilikema, “Litui lelalombika kupete lupija lukukome.”
Ndi gatimia gajwapwaga mlota waka Sapanga Yelemia pajwapwaga, “Bajukua mangengalema makomi matatu gulupija yebajetangana bandu buku Izilaeli kundepe,
balombila litui la bandu babomba ibega, ngati Bambu hejanagalakiya nepani.”
Pilatu andaluki Yesu
Yesu jajemiki palongi juku nkolongu ju Loma. Ndi Nkolongu hoju anndalukia, “Boo, weapa lee ndi Bambu Nkolongu jwa Ayaude?” Yesu japwaga, “Upwagiki weapa.”
Lakini agolu akolongu na aseja pababia atenda kuntaki, ngasejwajibwiki lilobe.
Ndienu pilatu andalukia Yesu, “Boo, ngasegujogwana matakilu gabugutakali weapa?”
Lakini Yesu ngase jwajibwiki hata lilobi limu, nkolongu juku Loma jola jwasangi ngamaa.
Yesu buntemu jukomika
Kila lisoba la tipati ja Pasaka, nkolongu juku Loma jayobali kunhuhogule mpungwa jumu bandu babumpai.
Masoba gala jwabi mpungwa jumu jojwamanyikini ngamaa, liina laki Balaba.
Ndi bandu hebakusanyiki pamu, Pilatu jwaalalukia, “Mpala nunhogulia nyane kati ja bandu abeli haba? Boo, nundekakiya Balaba au Yesu jobunkema Kilisituje?”
Pilatu jwapwaga hela ndaba jwamanyiki bundeta Yesu kwaki ndaba bumbonila wipu.
Pilatu pajwabia jutemi pikiteu sukutemu, nhwanu waki ampelakia lilobi, “Wiitenda sokapi kwaka mundu ajo jwanga mahakau, ndaba lelenu ikilu ng'aliki ngamaa nndotu ndaba jaki.”
Lakini agolu akolongu naaka aseja baakolua bandu bundoba Pilatu bunndekakia Balaba na Yesu jukuwa.
Pilatu jwaalalukia kabee, “Jwaa kati ja baamba jompala nundekakiyaje?” Bajibua, “Balaba!”
Pilatu jwaalalukia, “Henu nuntenda boo Yesu jobunkema Kilisitu?” Boti bapwaga, “Umbambaliaje pu nsalaba!”
Pilatu jwaalalukia, “Ndaba ja kike? Jutei ubaja bole?” Bombi baendalia kujamali kwa sauti koni bakapwaga, “Umbambalia punsalaba!”

Pilatu hejwamanya ngajuwesi kutenda sokapi na puju japala kutumbuli, jwajukua masi, nukusamba maboku palongi ja bandu bala nukupwaga, “Nengasemii na mahakau kupete kuwa kwaka mundu ajo, namu kwali mwabee.”
Bandu boka bapwaga, “Mahakau ga kuwa kwaki gabiya panani jitu na panani ja bana bitu!”
Ndipala Pilatu andekakiya Balaba ndaba jabu jupita mukipungu, na jaapwagila bunndapula Yesu iboku nukumbambali pu nsalaba.
Alonda bunndongama Yesu
Ndienu alonda baka Pilatu bumpelika Yesu mu nyumba jaka Pilatu, nu nsambi wa alonda bunnyongulota Yesu.
Bunhula ingobu yaki, bunhuwatika lingobu likeli lu ubambu.
Ndipala baloka kihilingu sa miha, nukunhwatika kumutu jaki, bumbekila kabee nndai mu kuboku kwaki kwa malele. Bapega magoti palongi jaki, bundongama bapwaaga, “Jambu oti Bambu nkolongu jwa Ayaudi!”
Bunhunila imata, buujukua nndai gola, bundapula nagu kumutu.
Pabajomula kundongama, bunhula kanzu ngeli jela nukunhwatika kabee ingobu yaki. Nukumpeleka kumbambali punsalaba.
Yesu bumbambali pu nsalaba
Pababia atenda kujenda, baketangana na mundu jumu bunkema Simoni, mwenei juku Kilene, bunndasimisa kutoto nsalaba waka Yesu.
Pabahika pandu pabapakema Goligota maana jaki pandu pi Lihupa li Kimutu,
Bumpekia divai jeahangangini na sindu sekibaba, lakini Yesu pajwaonza jwakanaa kunywa.
Batenda kumbambali pu nsalaba, nukubagana ingobu yaki sukugapege gudugudu.
Ndienu pala batama pai koni bukunndonda.
Panani jaki babeka lilobi lelilangi ndaba jukutakiliwa kwaki: “Jonzo ndi Yesu Bambu Nkolongu jwa Ayaudi.”
Bii abeli nabombi baabambalia panani ju nsalaba pamu na Yesu, jumu upandi uku mangegi na gongi upandi uku malele.
Bandu bababia apeta pala, banyua imutu yabu koni bukundongama nukuntondoo bakapwaga,
“Oo! We si wapwaga wiibombula nyumba jaka Sapanga nukusenga masoba gatatu? Henu, uliokua wa mweti! Ana sakaka weapa wa mwana waka Sapanga huluka pu nsalaba hapa sajenu!”
Ahelahe agolu akolongu pamu na abola ba Malagalaki na aseja nabombi batenda kunndongama koni bakapwaga,
“Jwaakombula bangi, lakini jusindwa kulioko mweni! Ati jombi Bambu nkolongu jwa Ayahude! Henu julihulua pu nsalaba natwepani tunhobaliaje.
Jombi anhobalia Sapanga na jwapwaga jombi Mwana waka Sapanga. Ana Sapanga ampala jombi anhokuaje.
“Kabee bababi abambaliwi pu nsalaba pamu najombi batenda kuntondo.”
Yesu jukua pu nsalaba
Tumbuka lisaa la sita mbaka lisaa la tisa, lwii lwijiyekalia ndema joti.
Hekwabia saa tisa lyobamutu Yesu jwalela sukujamali, “Eloi, Eloi Lama sabakitani?” Maana jaki, “Sapanga wangu, Sapanga wangu, ndaba jaki undei kuneka?”
Bandu bangi babajemiki pala bala pabajogwana bapwaga, “Ankema Elia.”
Apalapa jumu wabu jwaboka imbelu nukujuku kipongu, nukukijingi mu divai jejibaba nukukikonga punndai nukuntondabake Yesu jukunywa.
Bangi bapwaaga, “Tunndolake hoti ana Elia juhika kugombo.”
Yesu jwalela kabee sukujamali kwa sauti ngolongu, ndienu na kuwa.
Apalapa lipazia lu mu Nyumba jaka Sapanga lajenduka ipandi ibeli, toka kunani mbaka pai, ndema jatenda kubagaja malibu makolongu gatenda kusekuka,
mmatenge gatenda kuhukuka na bandu bingi baka Sapanga babawi batenda kuyoka.
Nabombi bapita kunza ja matenge na Yesu pajayoka bajenda ku musi wa sapi uku Yelusalemu na bandu bingi baabweni.
Ndienu nkolongu jwaalonda jumu na bangi bababia pamu najombi bukundonda Yesu, pababona kililima sa ndema na majambu gagapitila gala, bajogupa ngamaa, bapwaga, “Sakaka jonzo jabii Mwana waka Sapanga.”
Pandu je pala babii aka mbomba abeli bakalingalia sukutali. Haba ndi babumpwata Yesu kuhuma ku Galilaya ndi babuhudumia.
Jwabii Malia juku Magidala na Malia amabu baka Yakobu na Josepu na amabu baka bana baka Zebedayu.
Kuntaga Yesu
Pakamihi jwahika mundu jumu mwana mali mwenei juku Alimatayo, liina laki Josepu. Najombi jwabia mbolee waka Yesu.
Anzendila Pilatu nukuloba ampekia nhyega jaka Yesu. Ndienu Pilatu jwalagalakia bumpekya.
Josepu jwajukua nhyega jaka Yesu jela, jwiiyongalatia ingobu nhuu.
Josepu jabeka nhyega jaka Yesu nkati jilitenge laki linyai lejwabi julisongiki mweni pililibu. Ndienu juliingalatiya lilibu likolongu palongi junndyangu ulitengee nu kuboka.
Malia juku Magidala na Malia jongi jola babia atemi papu kulilingali litengee.
Alonda bililonda litenge
Kilabu jaki, labia lisoba lukuandaa Lisoba lu Kupomulela, Agolu akolongu na aka Afalisayu bunzendila Pilatu,
bumpwagila, “Nkolongo, tukomboka jojulonge isoli jola pajabi mwomi jwapwaga ati, ‘Nagapetiki masoba matatu nitenda kuyoka.’

Enu gulagalakia litenge laki bililonda sapi mbaka lisoba la tatu ili banafunzi baki bihika kujiba nhyega jaki nakaapwaji bandu jutei kuyoka. Isoli heji jamwisu jibia jiliya ngani kupeta jejatumbulia.”
Pilatu jwapwaga, “Alonda mmbii nabu, nzendania mwaka londa ngati henhwesa.”
Ndi bajenda, bililonda litenge, bilibeka halama panani ji lilibu lela nakaabeka alonda.
